tools.name: get_uk_fuel_prices
tools.description: UK average pump prices for diesel and petrol, pence per litre, one row per week (DESNZ weekly road fuel prices, newest first, last 26 weeks).

tools.name: get_fleet_cost_index
tools.description: THRIVE's weekly Fleet Cost Index: the energy cost per mile of a diesel van against an electric van (home, public and blended charging), and the ratio between them.

tools.name: get_electric_van_break_even
tools.description: How many miles an electric van takes to repay its price premium over an equivalent diesel van in fuel savings, recomputed weekly.

tools.name: get_fleet_charging_costs
tools.description: Electricity prices and cost per mile for charging fleet vehicles at a depot (DESNZ non-domestic prices by business size), at home (Ofgem price cap) and on public chargers.

tools.name: get_charging_cost_gap
tools.description: How much more public EV charging costs per mile than home charging, on HMRC's advisory electric rates.

tools.name: get_cost_to_charge_at_home
tools.description: The real cost per mile of charging an electric vehicle at home from the DESNZ average domestic electricity price, against HMRC's advisory electric rate.

tools.name: get_fuel_bill_index
tools.description: UK diesel pump price rebased to 100 at a base week: how much a fleet's fuel bill has moved since.

tools.name: get_company_car_tax_rates
tools.description: HMRC benefit-in-kind appropriate percentages for company cars by CO2 band and electric range, for every legislated tax year.

tools.name: get_hmrc_fleet_rates
tools.description: Current HMRC advisory fuel rates (AFR) for company cars by engine size, the advisory electric rates for home and public charging, and the constants THRIVE's indices use.

tools.name: get_fleet_rate_card
tools.description: THRIVE's Fleet Rate Card: advisory fuel rates, BiK, mileage allowance, eVED, the ZEV mandate, the van grant, van benefit and the upcoming dates that change them, each with its official source.

tools.name: search_vans
tools.description: Search THRIVE's database of vans and pickups on sale in the UK, every figure from the manufacturer's UK documents. Filter by text (make, model or size code), powertrain, size class, minimum payload, minimum range and maximum price. Returns up to 25 vans with headline figures; use get_van for the ful

tools.name: get_van
tools.description: The full specification of one van version in THRIVE's UK van database: price, grant, payload, gross weight, load dimensions, power, economy or range, battery and charging. Pass the slug from search_vans.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: THRIVE's reference guides for UK fleets and leasing companies (company car and van tax, eVED, payrolling benefits, charging reimbursement, van sizes, electric vans, tachographs, licence checks, operator licences), each sourced from GOV.UK and HMRC and reviewed on a schedule.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: The full text of one THRIVE guide as Markdown, with its review date and sources. Pass the slug from list_guides.

tools.name: search_fleet_news
tools.description: Search THRIVE's UK fleet news and analysis by keyword. Returns up to 15 stories, newest first, with date, summary and URL.
